DASHBOARD_HOSTNAME.description: Optional dashboard hostname in your Cloudflare account, such as auth-dashboard.example.com. Leave empty for workers.dev.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your dashboard owner. Verify this email during first sign-in.

CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID.description: An active DNS zone in your account for the secure packet gateway.

PROVISIONING_TOKEN.description: Your Cloudflare API token for the dashboard (see the guide for its permissions). Stored only in your installation.

COMPANY_NAME.description: Your company name, used for dashboard emails.

SIGNIN_HOSTNAME.description: Optional sign-in hostname in the same zone, such as signin.example.com. Leave empty to use signin.<zone>.
